data.one_liner: Date and time library with support for timezones, calendars, cultures, formatting and parsing.
data.what_it_does: Time Machine provides an alternative date and time API over Dart Core with support for timezones, calendars, cultures, formatting, and parsing. It is a port of Noda Time designed for Flutter, Web, and Server.
use_when: You need robust timezone and calendar calculations.
You require culture-aware date and time formatting and parsing.
avoid_when: You only need basic, localized-free DateTime operations provided by dart:core.
strengths: Consistency across platforms including Web, Flutter, and Server
Comprehensive timezone and calendar system support
weaknesses: Requires manual asset configuration for timezones and cultures in Flutter
Preview status with some ongoing API stabilization
data.setup_notes: Requires adding TZDB and culture binary assets to pubspec.yaml for Flutter and calling TimeMachine.initialize().
